import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core'; import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button'; import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext'; import type { HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http'; import { AuthService } from '@core/auth/auth.service'; import type { ApiErrorBody } from '@shared/models/api.models'; /** * Login (plan 20). The organization identity on full display: ink-brown side panel * with a repeating eight-point star lattice, a large Amiri display title, * ledger-rule separators, and a staggered form reveal. Eight colors only, * hard edges, no blur — the paper-and-ink aesthetic (plan 9). */ @Component({ selector: 'app-login', standalone: true, imports: [TranslatePipe, FormsModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule], template: `

{{ 'app.name' | translate }}

{{ 'auth.login.org_hint' | translate }}

{{ 'auth.login.feat_track' | translate }}
{{ 'auth.login.feat_secure' | translate }}

v1.0 — {{ 'app.name' | translate }}

{{ 'auth.login.title' | translate }}

{{ 'auth.login.subtitle' | translate }}

@if (error()) {
{{ error() }}
}

© {{ year }} {{ 'common.company' | translate }}. {{ 'common.rights' | translate }}

`, changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, }) export class LoginComponent { private auth = inject(AuthService); private router = inject(Router); year = new Date().getFullYear(); email = signal(''); password = signal(''); remember = signal(false); sending = signal(false); error = signal(''); showPassword = signal(false); submit(): void { this.error.set(''); this.sending.set(true); this.auth.login(this.email(), this.password(), this.remember()).subscribe({ next: () => { const target = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('returnUrl') ?? '/dashboard'; window.location.assign('/app' + target); }, error: (err: HttpErrorResponse) => { this.sending.set(false); const body = err.error as ApiErrorBody | null; this.error.set(body?.message ?? 'errors.generic'); }, }); } }
